source_alignment.purpose: Test whether QA residuals can drive variation/evaluation/selective retention of retrieval policies. This is not a full HippoRAG reproduction and does not use live reader answers.

variation.claim: Yes/no comparison questions with two named entities fail when retrieval covers one side only; force dual entity anchors and PPR evidence before reading.
variation.trigger: question starts with a binary auxiliary, contains 'and', and exposes at least two capitalized anchors
variation.expected_effect: Increase all-support recall on comparison questions without changing unrelated rows.
variation.risk: Overfitting to surface capitalization; gate requires no support or answer-coverage regression.

variation.claim: Wh-questions with a named anchor can miss the anchor page; explicitly bridge through exact title anchors.
variation.trigger: question is a wh-question and contains at least one capitalized anchor
variation.expected_effect: Recover missing bridge pages when BM25 locks onto answer-like text.
variation.risk: Can push already-complete BM25 evidence out of top-k; should be rejected if harms occur.

variation.claim: Pseudo-relevance feedback from the first BM25 passages can expand implicit bridge terms for multi-hop QA.
variation.expected_effect: Improve supporting-fact fraction on residual rows with incomplete evidence chains.
variation.risk: Top passage terms can amplify a wrong first hop; should be rejected if support-chain regressions appear.

evaluation.claim: Yes/no comparison questions with two named entities fail when retrieval covers one side only; force dual entity anchors and PPR evidence before reading.
evaluation.trigger: question starts with a binary auxiliary, contains 'and', and exposes at least two capitalized anchors
evaluation.expected_effect: Increase all-support recall on comparison questions without changing unrelated rows.
evaluation.risk: Overfitting to surface capitalization; gate requires no support or answer-coverage regression.

evaluation.claim: Wh-questions with a named anchor can miss the anchor page; explicitly bridge through exact title anchors.
evaluation.trigger: question is a wh-question and contains at least one capitalized anchor
evaluation.expected_effect: Recover missing bridge pages when BM25 locks onto answer-like text.
evaluation.risk: Can push already-complete BM25 evidence out of top-k; should be rejected if harms occur.

evaluation.claim: Pseudo-relevance feedback from the first BM25 passages can expand implicit bridge terms for multi-hop QA.
evaluation.expected_effect: Improve supporting-fact fraction on residual rows with incomplete evidence chains.
evaluation.risk: Top passage terms can amplify a wrong first hop; should be rejected if support-chain regressions appear.

selective_retention.policy: Apply accepted narrow hypotheses by deterministic trigger; otherwise keep ordinary BM25.

recursive_trace.observation: HippoRAG QA probe showed structural morphism abstains on factual QA, so QA uses BM25 fallback.
Generated 3 retrieval hypotheses from incomplete-support residuals.
Retained accepted narrow policies and left all other rows on BM25 fallback.
